summary.headline: Dragon’s Head and Tail in the Houses
summary.text: Chapter 48 explains the effects of the Dragon’s Head and Tail in the first eight houses of heaven, including fortune, wealth, siblings, estates, children, servants, animals, marriage, enemies, and longevity.
